Rachel / Steph —

Quick technical note and proposed fix: when you forward or reattach the ICS from within Gmail, the organizer field can be stripped and the calendar entry becomes 'orphaned' in recipients' calendars (it appears as a separate event that your account no longer controls). That can create duplicates and leave RSVPs disconnected. To avoid that, I recommend creating a brand new calendar event (don't forward/attach the old ICS) and include a Zoom meeting URL in the event body.

I've created a new meeting and exported a fresh ICS (demo_regen_zoom.ics) that includes the Zoom join URL and a passcode. Attaching it here for record — I'll let Rachel post the new event from her calendar so she's the organizer.

Attachment: demo_regen_zoom.ics
